name: Shin Koihime † Musou ~Moeshouden~
source:
Moeshouden is the final game in the Koihime series. In this fandisk, there’s no more fighting among the factions. Instead, all 52 heroines fight for Kazuto’s love. Or maybe he can settle for a harem in the true sense of the word.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/07/01/july-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
《萌将传》是《恋姬》系列最终作。在这部资料片中，各阵营不再相互征战，而是由全部52名女主角争夺一刀的爱情。又或许，他可以建立一个真正意义上的后宫。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/07/01/july-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
